description: The Blog section's launch-state card inviting visitors to subscribe on Substack before the first post exists.
name: BlogEmptyCard

description: Home page Blog section: ochre bracket label, heading, All posts link, and the newest three Substack posts as cards; shows the subscribe card when there are no posts yet.
name: BlogSection

description: Tilted book cover image, or a salmon title card when no cover is set.
name: BookCover

description: One book: cover beside eyebrow, title, subtitle, blurb and optional main and secondary links.
name: BookFeature

description: Home Books band; stacks a BookFeature per published book.
name: BooksSection

description: Inline SVG bracket logo with the three-line wordmark, in a light (header) or dark (footer) tone.
name: BracketLogo

description: A CMS pages entry rendered as a title over its markdown body.
name: ContentPage

description: Footer nav row mirroring the main nav links as plain ink links.
name: FooterNav

description: Home hero on the navy band: CMS eyebrow, site title, MissionLine and HeroQuote.
name: Hero

description: One quote with attribution in the hero aside.
name: HeroQuote

description: The page h1, visually hidden so it stays available to screen readers and search engines.
name: HiddenPageTitle

untestabilityReason.justification: one sr-only h1 rendering a single text prop

description: Periwinkle Learn More band with a CMS heading and a button to the About page.
name: LearnMore

description: Header home link wrapping the light bracket logo, labelled with the site title.
name: LogoLink

description: Header nav links on the navy band with the call-to-action link as the white button; a dropdown panel below 860px when opened.
name: MainNav

description: Outlined Menu/Close button shown below 860px that reveals the main nav.
name: MenuToggle

description: Hero mission sentence with the rotating typewriter word, sized to the longest word and readable by screen readers.
name: MissionLine

untestabilityReason.justification: Its only behavior is a timer-driven word rotation with no click, fill, or press to replay; the step logic is unit-tested in typewriter.test.ts and the rotation was driven and captured in the demo flow.

description: 404 page body: bracket label, heading, and a link back to the home page.
name: NotFound

description: One Substack post card: cover, optional category pill, UTC date, title clamped to four lines, and Read post link to the post on Substack.
name: PostCard

description: A blog card cover: the post's Substack cover image, or an ochre panel with the site name when the post has none.
name: PostCover

description: Home page section placeholder carrying the id the nav links to; later plans fill each one.
name: SectionAnchor

description: Site footer: navy bracket logo, footer nav from nav.json, and the copyright line from settings.footerText.
name: SiteFooter

description: Navy header band from the mockup: bracket-logo home link, main nav from nav.json, and the mobile Menu/Close toggle wired by bindMobileMenu.
name: SiteHeader

description: One tool card: bracket icon, name, description and arrow when it links somewhere.
name: ToolCard

description: Home Technology band with up to three ToolCards; hidden when no tools are published.
name: ToolsSection

description: Normalize an XML parser value that may be missing, a single node, or a list into an array, so feeds with zero, one or many items/enclosures/categories parse the same way.
name: asArray

description: Wires the mobile Menu/Close toggle: each button click flips the menu and following any nav link closes it.
name: bindMobileMenu

description: Decode named, decimal and hex HTML entities left undecoded inside CDATA in Substack titles and summaries; unknown entities are kept as written.
name: decodeEntities

description: Astro integration whose build-done hook deletes the isolated-components folder from the build output so the committed capture pages never ship.
name: excludeIsolationPages

description: The RSS feed URL for a Substack home URL from the substackUrl setting, appending /feed and stripping trailing slashes.
name: feedUrlFor

description: Format a post's ISO date as a short US date in UTC so the build machine timezone never shifts the day; empty string for an invalid date.
name: formatPostDate

description: Reads the editable nav.json singleton from the active data root on every call.
name: getNav

untestabilityReason.justification: filesystem read at the data root; the root resolution itself is tested via resolveDataRoot

description: Reads the editable settings.json singleton from the active data root on every call, so CMS edits and seeded scenarios show without a server restart.
name: getSettings

untestabilityReason.justification: filesystem read at the data root; the root resolution itself is tested via resolveDataRoot

description: Read synced posts from substackPosts.json under the data root on every call; a missing or malformed snapshot means no posts rather than a broken build.
name: getSubstackPosts

description: Starting state of the hero typewriter: the first word on screen, ready to delete.
name: initialTypewriterState

description: True when a URL or pathname has an isolated-components path segment; used by the sitemap filter to drop dev-only capture pages.
name: isIsolationPath

description: True inside astro build, so a production build always resolves committed content and ignores any sandbox override in the environment.
name: isProductionBuild

description: Log why the Substack sync is skipping (no URL, fetch failure, non-RSS body) and exit successfully, leaving the existing snapshot in place so the deploy still builds.
name: keep

untestabilityReason.justification: Logs a warning and exits the Node process; the network/filesystem boundary of the sync script.

description: The newest N posts (default three) sorted newest first, without mutating the input; drives which cards the Blog section shows.
name: latestPosts

description: Joins the mission words into a screen-reader sentence with an Oxford comma.
name: listForReaders

description: Returns the longest mission word, used to size the typewriter slot so the line never shifts.
name: longestWord

description: Whether a fetched body is an RSS feed at all (has a channel element), so the sync never overwrites the last good snapshot with an error page.
name: looksLikeRssFeed

description: Label for the mobile nav toggle: Close when the menu is open, Menu when closed.
name: menuLabel

description: Parses the hero's rotating mission words from the missionWords setting: one per line, trimmed, blank lines dropped, falling back to people.
name: parseMissionWords

description: Parse a Substack RSS feed into normalized posts (title, url, ISO date, optional summary, cover image from enclosure, first category), newest first; skips incomplete items and returns an empty list for malformed XML instead of throwing.
name: parseSubstackFeed

description: Returns the lowest-ordered CMS entry, or undefined for an empty collection; picks the hero quote.
name: pickFirstByOrder

description: The single frame a pinned rotating word holds: the first word for static, or the whole next word after one reduced-motion swap for reduced.
name: pinnedTypewriterText

description: Reads and parses one JSON singleton (settings or nav) from the active data root, fresh on every call.
name: readSingleton

untestabilityReason.justification: filesystem read and JSON.parse at the data root; root resolution is tested via resolveDataRoot

description: Resolves the content collection root: the CODEYAM_CONTENT_ROOT sandbox override during an editor session, committed src/content otherwise and always in a production build.
name: resolveContentRoot

description: Resolves the site data root for settings.json and nav.json: the CODEYAM_DATA_ROOT sandbox override during an editor session, committed src/data otherwise and always in a production build.
name: resolveDataRoot

description: Shared resolution for the content and data roots: env override during dev and tests, the committed default otherwise and always in production.
name: resolveRoot

description: Opens or closes the mobile nav, keeping the nav's open class, the toggle's aria-expanded, and its label in sync.
name: setMenuOpen

description: Sorts CMS entries by their optional numeric order; unordered entries go last and ties keep incoming order.
name: sortByOrder

description: Read a feed field as trimmed, entity-decoded text whether the parser returned a plain value or a node with #text; missing fields read as an empty string.
name: text

description: Shapes editable nav.json items into header/footer links: skips items without a url, routes hrefs through withBase, and flags the last link as the call-to-action button.
name: toNavLinks

description: Reads the screenshot flag ?typewriter=static or ?typewriter=reduced from a query string; returns null for visitors and for unknown values so the rotating word keeps animating.
name: typewriterPin

description: Pure state machine for the rotating mission word: deletes, types, holds, and wraps words, or swaps whole words under reduced motion, returning the next delay.
name: typewriterStep

description: Caps the home Technology section at three tools; an empty result hides the section.
name: visibleTools

description: Wraps the CMS collectionLoader so a collection whose folder starts empty still picks up its first entry under astro dev; Astro's glob loader skips watching empty folders.
name: watchedCollectionLoader

description: Prefixes an internal link or asset path with the active deploy base (the GitHub Pages subpath today, the domain root later); section anchors resolve to the home page and external URLs pass through unchanged.
name: withBase
